annotations.title: Read a document to change it

description: Returns the current contents of a document on HTMLRadar so they can be changed and put back with replace_document. A change to a page already on HTMLRadar is made this way, for pages up to 30 MB, the same limit as the website: read the page here, then send the edited short form, or only the changes, to replace_document; a whole new file is needed only to replace the page itself. Each embedded PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP image appears as a short htmlradar-image reference instead of its data; unchanged references restore the original images, and other embedded images, such as SVG, stay in the markup. Up to 5 MB of text and code, with its images as references, the whole page comes back. Between 5 MB and 20 MB it is too large to return whole: pass `query`, a word or phrase from the part to change, and it returns up to 20 passages where that text appears, exact text for `edits`. Over 20 MB of text and code besides its images, the page cannot be read or changed here. A document served from its own address has no stored contents to return. It reads only this account's documents and changes nothing.

document_id.description: The document to read: the document id from list_documents or list_shares.

query.description: Text to find, 1 to 200 characters, matched literally with letter case ignored, such as a product name or a price. Returns up to 20 passages around the matches, and how many there are, instead of the whole page. For a page too large to read whole, the passages provide exact text for edits.
